svg.text: loop: the same call a third
nudge: it said it would act, but did not
ledger: does the record of edits
the reason goes back to the model
as the result of its finish call,
What run() in src/harness.ts does, in order. Each step, one model call; the loop repeats until the finish gate lets it stop.
Each check refuses at most twice, so the gate cannot lock the run.
